title: Deye three-phase hybrid Modbus register map (public translated mirror)
summary: A public English translation mirror of Deye Modbus RTU V1.04 defines holding-register telemetry at 500-683 and writable settings at 60-499 using FC 0x10. The integration implements a bounded operational subset whose register encoding and scale are unambiguous: power, battery, charging, generator, smart-load, export, metering, six-period TOU, topology, and selected advanced feature fields. Factory/debug/calibration, BMS-owned runtime words, parallel-cluster addressing, ambiguous fields, and grid-code/certification curves are deliberately excluded. The observed Kevolt proxy trace independently corroborates the telemetry addresses, most scales, and limiter register 142. The document remains register-map evidence, not proof of model identity or successful hardware writes.
